name: SpatialPosters
description: High-quality crowdsourced artwork for media servers.

SPATIALPOSTERS_TMDB_KEY.description: TMDB v3 API Key required for fetching default artwork.

SPATIALPOSTERS_PUBLIC_INSTANCE.description: Set to 1 to enable public multi-user instance mode.

SPATIALPOSTERS_DATA_DIR.description: Path to data storage. Leave default for Heroku ephemeral storage or mount a volume if possible.
